input.notes: Global object guard applies; discovery descriptor is not success output evidence. Native body string is exact UTF8 JSON, no file interpretation, actor, key or extra envelope. Original payload is structured, never body string. Current protocol rust-http-v1, no legacy envelope normalization. year present even null rejected before DomainReadArgs; absent optional year defaults None.

success.invariants: Native structuredContent={ok: upstream.ok when boolean else true,data: upstream}; isError=(structuredContent.ok==false). HTTP nested wrapper preserved; no flattening. PDF SDK synthesizes ok:true and preview/pdf object.
success.serialization: content is exactly one text item; text equals compact JSON serialization of structuredContent, not a separate producer. JSON-RPC2.0 id echoes request. HTTP status is not a success field.

refusal.semantics: Non2xx native HTTP bodies discarded, not reflected. request() POST5xx -> outcome_unknown; all other non2xx -> server_refused/status. GET non2xx -> server_refused. Post-dispatch write send/read/invalid2xx JSON/oversize -> outcome_unknown; GET send/read -> transport, invalid/oversize2xx -> protocol. Preview post-send maps unknown to transport; preview and invoice_pdf use read_pdf and non2xx server_refused, MIME/signature/oversize protocol. Error Display strings: invalid_input => "invalid input: {static source reason}"; transport => "server transport failed"; server_refused => "server refused request (HTTP {status})"; protocol => "invalid server response"; outcome_unknown => "operation outcome unknown; reconcile server state before retrying". Original confirm error exactly "confirm: true required for write tool {name}".

currentHttpFailures.422: NotCommitted engine code/message exact; source-derived code/errors not a fabricated common business status. Original apply can instead return HTTP200 {ok:false,errors:[message]} for input/selector/account-selection errors.

refusal.controls: Origin host/fetch-site proof; current cookie or supported scoped service key (never mixed). Current MFA, grants, transfer/backup/source/closed-period controls can refuse. Service failure includes usage/business stages, never proof that a retry is free or safe.

parseProtocol.transport: 1MiB UTF8 newline-delimited frames for all selected tools. Invalid JSON or missing final newline -> -32700 id:null. Oversized -> error response then stderr message limit exceeded and process exit1. Ordinary request errors do not exit. EOF exit0. Config/local credential file/runtime setup failures are stderr only: config exit2, serve failure exit1; no JSON-RPC tool result or stdout banner.
parseProtocol.session: Initialize then notifications/initialized. Notifications never execute tools or respond. IDs string<=256 UTF8 bytes or signed64/unsigned64 integer; no null/fraction. IDs cannot repeat, retained maximum100000; sequential tool execution. Extra request/params properties ignored; params must object; task presence refused. Unknown method -32601; tool dispatch/parser error -32602.
parseProtocol.sdk: Per-send bare /api/protocol preflight errors map protocol before dependent dispatch, never retry. Sends origin + protocol1/current manifest/rust-http-v1, cookie OR service-key. No redirects/proxy inheritance; connect10s/total30s. Post-dispatch send/read errors -> outcome_unknown on writes, transport on reads. JSON success >16MiB or invalid JSON -> outcome_unknown on writes, protocol on reads. Response media-type is not validated by request().
parseProtocol.argumentParsing: tools::call explicitly requires arguments.is_object() BEFORE every selected dispatch. Therefore no positional-array MCP arguments, notwithstanding derived Serde struct internals. tools/list advertises object schemas. serde_json::Value frame parsing collapses duplicate JSON object names to last value before argument validation, recursively; unlike strict original HTTP Unique parser. Unknown native argument map fields rejected. Original flat object validates allowed keys and rejects null for provided fields. Body strings are not rewritten.
parseProtocol.bodyParsing: Native SDK body() parses serde_json::Value and requires object; duplicate fields collapse for validation, but original body bytes are forwarded and native derived Serde HTTP parser rejects duplicate recognized fields. Original structured tools reserialize objects after last-value collapse, insert confirm:true for validation, and reject unknown/null payload fields before network. Original HTTP Unique rejects duplicate fields at every depth. Native HTTP from_slice derived Customer/Input/Post/settlement/credit accepts positional arrays absent an object guard: schemas and exact order below distinguish this direct HTTP behavior from the object-only MCP/SDK path.

nativeSerdeSequences.length: Sequence requires every declared position including Option fields (use null for None), exact tuple length; no trailing/missing positions. Map Option defaults absent/null to None; required non-Option cannot be absent/null. These shapes do not override earlier MCP/SDK object guard.

parseProtocol.nativeHttp: SDK body() <=262144 bytes and JSON object, strict known fields/types/enums/length/numeric bounds. It ignores pattern and oneOf; server validates dates/financial meaning, not discovery alone. Native HTTP serde permits sequences listed above and rejects duplicate recognized fields/unknown maps. JSON body content-type exactly application/json case-insensitive; content-encoding rejected; to_bytes256KiB ->413. General query supports year/account/format/source singleton nonempty <=128, trimmed/no controls or replacement char; source live|archive. Sales rejects account/format, year except invoices. source parsed but sales does not consume it: no invented archive selection. HEAD is not a tool and HTTP HEAD wire body empty, never GET constructor JSON.

binary.representation: MCP JSON only; native HTTP application/pdf raw bytes becomes SDK preview/pdf {contentType:application/pdf,bytes:[0..255]}; no local files. read_pdf checks first content-type segment exactly application/pdf (parameters tolerated), prefix %PDF-, <=16MiB. Original invoice_render returns reference/hash receipt, NOT PDF bytes. Content text includes full JSON byte array.

paginationFilterOrder.semantics: No pagination/filter/query arguments on this tool. contacts customers/vendors archived=0 ORDER BY name,id, aggregate currently positive customer principal in DKK; GDPR overlay adds gdprErased without mutating originals. All native HTTP general query duplicates refused; source may parse but is not consumed by sales. No client sorting/calculation.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision/If-Match token or supported optimistic revision input; current source integrity and writer transaction, posting rule version/current configured role accounts, original debtor/VAT, period bounds and live rights remain authoritative. No client-computed totals or discovery hints replace those controls.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: No confirmation argument; original render exception requires true despite verification-only behavior.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Current company/context and unexpired MFA human or explicit supported current service grants; backup/write/transfer fences and immutable original verification remain. No actor/password/secret/account identity inferred by MCP. Native credit_invoice/refund_invoice human-only sales branch; original lifecycle/service path retains its actual current grant checks.

key.meaning: No client idempotency key accepted or promised for these tools. JSON-RPC id is correlation, session reuse refused; invoice number/selector and bank reference are not replay keys.

retry.naturalDedup: Current ledger controls refuse already-posted invoice, reused imported bank row and over-credit/refund; not replay receipts. Customer uniqueness and consecutive numbering are constraints, not operation identity. Partial credit with new number can legitimately create another credit; never resend to discover prior outcome.

readBack.authority: Use same authoritative workspace/company ledgerUuid and current authorized session/service; canonical invoices and invoice_status exact invoiceDocumentId, invoiceNumber, payments/paymentId/journalEntryId, creditNotes/documentId and refunds/refundId; verify immutable documents/PDF and journal plus imported bank identity/source and links. create_customer: contacts exact returned id and immutable request identity, not name alone.
readBack.unknown: After outcome_unknown stop writes and reconcile exact invoice/journal/evidence and bank linkage with retained source/receipt. No automatic replay, replacement key/number, send/post/reissue from reused receipt. No MCP recovery/repair tool advertised. Resolve with authorized operator if evidence cannot establish outcome.
readBack.absence: Absence is NOT proof of noncommit if authority, access, source, selected year or workspace changed, or read failed. Native invoices is year-scoped; original list/status covers all years and validates source histories. A successful read never itself grants resend permission.

retry.unresolvedProvider: These operations perform no external delivery/provider call. Existing PEPPOL projections can report uncertain/in_progress/queued/legacy; readback does not send, refresh or resolve provider uncertainty. Original render verifies existing immutable PDF only. Never reuse receipt to post/send/reissue as a new operation.

Unique recursive duplicate rejection; storage validate strict objects/no unknown/null. HEAD implicit route handling is not an MCP tool; wire body always empty, including errors.

binary.representation: MCP JSON only; native HTTP application/pdf raw bytes becomes SDK preview/pdf {contentType:application/pdf,bytes:[0..255]}; no local files. read_pdf checks first content-type segment exactly application/pdf (parameters tolerated), prefix %PDF-, <=16MiB. Original invoice_render returns reference/hash receipt, NOT PDF bytes. Content text includes full JSON byte array.

paginationFilterOrder.semantics: No cursor/offset/limit/pagination; all issued invoices across years. SDK query pairs occur status,from,to,customerCvr,customer,invoiceNumber,query,asOf,minAmount,maxAmount,amount,minDays,documentId; absent omitted, text untrimmed URL-form encoded; no duplicates produced. Pre-encoding sum key+value+2 <=4096; HTTP raw query <=4096, decoded each value nonempty <=1024 with no controls, malformed percent/duplicate/unknown/irrelevant names refused. Dates validated YYYY-MM-DD, status exact enum; minDays digits 0..9007199254740991, documentId digits 1..9007199254740991; numeric filters JSON finite Number, negatives allowed. Status documentId wins over invoiceNumber. Filters AND; number trimmed case-sensitive exact; customerCvr trimmed uppercase exact; customer and free query trim/lowercase literal substring (not SQL wildcard), query matches customerName OR invoiceNumber. amount overrides both min/max; inclusive date/gross bounds. asOf affects aging, not retained current financial histories. Sort effectiveDueDate asc, invoiceNumber asc, documentId asc; overdue first overdueDays desc, openBalance desc, then same tie breakers. Row history arrays retain SQL order: payments/refunds/claimPayments/creditNotes/writeoffs/corrections id asc; reminders/compensation/interest date,id asc. Each SQL rows() history limited5000 and8MiB, refusal not truncation. SDK response16MiB cap; no advertised list maximum.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision/If-Match token or supported optimistic revision input; current source integrity and writer transaction, posting rule version/current configured role accounts, original debtor/VAT, period bounds and live rights remain authoritative. No client-computed totals or discovery hints replace those controls.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: Original lifecycle requires confirm:true before network; omission/false after shape validation -> structured CONFIRM_REQUIRED with exact tool name. confirm nonboolean -> RPC -32602. confirm:true inserted only for validation, not authorization.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.authority: Current company/context and unexpired MFA human or explicit supported current service grants; backup/write/transfer fences and immutable original verification remain. No actor/password/secret/account identity inferred by MCP. Native credit_invoice/refund_invoice human-only sales branch; original lifecycle/service path retains its actual current grant checks.

key.meaning: No client idempotency key accepted or promised for these tools. JSON-RPC id is correlation, session reuse refused; invoice number/selector and bank reference are not replay keys.

retry.naturalDedup: Current ledger controls refuse already-posted invoice, reused imported bank row and over-credit/refund; not replay receipts. Customer uniqueness and consecutive numbering are constraints, not operation identity. Partial credit with new number can legitimately create another credit; never resend to discover prior outcome.

readBack.authority: Use same authoritative workspace/company ledgerUuid and current authorized session/service; canonical invoices and invoice_status exact invoiceDocumentId, invoiceNumber, payments/paymentId/journalEntryId, creditNotes/documentId and refunds/refundId; verify immutable documents/PDF and journal plus imported bank identity/source and links. create_customer: contacts exact returned id and immutable request identity, not name alone.
readBack.unknown: After outcome_unknown stop writes and reconcile exact invoice/journal/evidence and bank linkage with retained source/receipt. No automatic replay, replacement key/number, send/post/reissue from reused receipt. No MCP recovery/repair tool advertised. Resolve with authorized operator if evidence cannot establish outcome.
readBack.absence: Absence is NOT proof of noncommit if authority, access, source, selected year or workspace changed, or read failed. Native invoices is year-scoped; original list/status covers all years and validates source histories. A successful read never itself grants resend permission.

retry.unresolvedProvider: These operations perform no external delivery/provider call. Never reuse receipt to post/send/reissue as a new operation.

readBack.authority: Use same authoritative workspace/company ledgerUuid and current authorized session/service; canonical invoices and invoice_status exact invoiceDocumentId, invoiceNumber, payments/paymentId/journalEntryId, creditNotes/documentId and refunds/refundId; verify immutable documents/PDF and journal plus imported bank identity/source and links. create_customer: contacts exact returned id and immutable request identity, not name alone.
readBack.unknown: After outcome_unknown stop writes and reconcile exact invoice/journal/evidence and bank linkage with retained source/receipt. No automatic replay, replacement key/number, send/post/reissue from reused receipt. No MCP recovery/repair tool advertised. Resolve with authorized operator if evidence cannot establish outcome.
readBack.absence: Absence is NOT proof of noncommit if authority, access, source, selected year or workspace changed, or read failed. Native invoices is year-scoped; original list/status covers all years and validates source histories. A successful read never itself grants resend permission.

retry.unresolvedProvider: These operations perform no external delivery/provider call. Existing PEPPOL projections can report uncertain/in_progress/queued/legacy; readback does not send, refresh or resolve provider uncertainty. Original render verifies existing immutable PDF only. Never reuse receipt to post/send/reissue as a new operation.

input.notes: Global object guard applies; discovery descriptor is not success output evidence. Native body string is exact UTF8 JSON, no file interpretation, actor, key or extra envelope. Original payload is structured, never body string. Current protocol rust-http-v1, no legacy envelope normalization.

success.invariants: Original value preserved directly as structuredContent; isError=(value.ok != true). Success errors:[]; original envelope removes nested ok/errors and lifts appliedRules.
success.serialization: content is exactly one text item; text equals compact JSON serialization of structuredContent, not a separate producer. JSON-RPC2.0 id echoes request. HTTP status is not a success field.

refusal.semantics: HTTP422 complete bounded canonical ok:false/errors(nonempty strings)/nonblank code preserved, including code/appliedRules. HTTP2xx business ok:false/errors nonempty accepted directly. Malformed422 -> server_refused HTTP422. Non-render POST5xx or408 -> outcome_unknown before reading; other non2xx -> server_refused. Render maps post-send transport to transport, invalid2xx to protocol; 5xx/408 server_refused. GET non2xx except422 -> server_refused; invalid2xx -> protocol; failed body read -> transport. Error Display strings: invalid_input => "invalid input: {static source reason}"; transport => "server transport failed"; server_refused => "server refused request (HTTP {status})"; protocol => "invalid server response"; outcome_unknown => "operation outcome unknown; reconcile server state before retrying". Original confirm error exactly "confirm: true required for write tool {name}".

currentHttpFailures.422: NotCommitted engine code/message exact; source-derived code/errors not a fabricated common business status. Original apply can instead return HTTP200 {ok:false,errors:[message]} for input/selector/account-selection errors.

refusal.controls: Origin host/fetch-site proof; current cookie or supported scoped service key (never mixed). Current MFA, grants, transfer/backup/source/closed-period controls can refuse. Service failure includes usage/business stages, never proof that a retry is free or safe.

parseProtocol.transport: 1MiB UTF8 newline-delimited frames for all selected tools. Invalid JSON or missing final newline -> -32700 id:null. Oversized -> error response then stderr message limit exceeded and process exit1. Ordinary request errors do not exit. EOF exit0. Config/local credential file/runtime setup failures are stderr only: config exit2, serve failure exit1; no JSON-RPC tool result or stdout banner.
parseProtocol.session: Initialize then notifications/initialized. Notifications never execute tools or respond. IDs string<=256 UTF8 bytes or signed64/unsigned64 integer; no null/fraction. IDs cannot repeat, retained maximum100000; sequential tool execution. Extra request/params properties ignored; params must object; task presence refused. Unknown method -32601; tool dispatch/parser error -32602.
parseProtocol.sdk: Per-send bare /api/protocol preflight errors map protocol before dependent dispatch, never retry. Sends origin + protocol1/current manifest/rust-http-v1, cookie OR service-key. No redirects/proxy inheritance; connect10s/total30s. Post-dispatch send/read errors -> outcome_unknown on writes, transport on reads. JSON success >16MiB or invalid JSON -> outcome_unknown on writes, protocol on reads. Response media-type is not validated by request().
parseProtocol.argumentParsing: tools::call explicitly requires arguments.is_object() BEFORE every selected dispatch. Therefore no positional-array MCP arguments, notwithstanding derived Serde struct internals. tools/list advertises object schemas. serde_json::Value frame parsing collapses duplicate JSON object names to last value before argument validation, recursively; unlike strict original HTTP Unique parser. Unknown native argument map fields rejected. Original flat object validates allowed keys and rejects null for provided fields. Body strings are not rewritten.
parseProtocol.bodyParsing: Native SDK body() parses serde_json::Value and requires object; duplicate fields collapse for validation, but original body bytes are forwarded and native derived Serde HTTP parser rejects duplicate recognized fields. Original structured tools reserialize objects after last-value collapse, insert confirm:true for validation, and reject unknown/null payload fields before network. Original HTTP Unique rejects duplicate fields at every depth. Native HTTP from_slice derived Customer/Input/Post/settlement/credit accepts positional arrays absent an object guard: schemas and exact order below distinguish this direct HTTP behavior from the object-only MCP/SDK path.

nativeSerdeSequences.length: Sequence requires every declared position including Option fields (use null for None), exact tuple length; no trailing/missing positions. Map Option defaults absent/null to None; required non-Option cannot be absent/null. These shapes do not override earlier MCP/SDK object guard.

parseProtocol.originalHttp: Read exact GET-only, idempotency-key/content-encoding/transfer-encoding prohibited; content-length absent or exactly0. Unique recursive duplicate rejection; storage validate strict objects/no unknown/null. HEAD implicit route handling is not an MCP tool; wire body always empty, including errors.

binary.representation: MCP JSON only; native HTTP application/pdf raw bytes becomes SDK preview/pdf {contentType:application/pdf,bytes:[0..255]}; no local files. read_pdf checks first content-type segment exactly application/pdf (parameters tolerated), prefix %PDF-, <=16MiB. Each SQL rows() history limited5000 and8MiB, refusal not truncation. SDK response16MiB cap; no advertised list maximum.
